title: Miniprep (Ethanol Lysis)
author: Nicholas Coleman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9wsh7ee

steps.title: Grow Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a 10-15ml tube of LB-Antibiotic media with plasmid-containing bacteria and grow overnight in a 37°C incubator or water bath (ideally shaking).

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells in a 15mL Falcon tube by centrifuging at max speed for 5 minutes, then pour off the supernatant into liquid waste.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pelleted bacterial cells in 250μl Buffer P1 and transfer the suspension to a micro-centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Add 250μL buffer P2 to the tube and mix gently by inverting. Do not vortex to avoid shearing genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Continue inverting until the solution becomes viscous and slightly clear, if necessary.
Ensure the lysis reaction does not proceed for more than 5 min.
If LyseBlue or another indicator is present in P2, mix until a homogenous blue.

steps.title: Neutralize Lysis
steps.instruction: Add 350μl Buffer N3 and mix immediately and thoroughly by inverting the tube.

substeps.instruction: Invert 4–6 times for standard volumes; invert up to 10 times for large culture volumes (≥5 ml).
If LyseBlue was used, mix until the suspension is colorless.

steps.title: Clear Cellular Debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 min at max speed to form a compact yellow-white pellet.

steps.title: Precipitate Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the pellet using a micropipette and transfer to a microcentrifuge tube. Mix the supernatant in a 1:1 ratio with ethanol (approximately 750μL of Ethanol) by inverting the tube 10 times.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Apply the ethanol-supernatant mixture to a silica spin column in 750μL increments.

substeps.instruction: Decant or pipette 750μL into the top of the column and centrifuge for 30–60s.
Place the flow-through back into the spin column and centrifuge again for 30–60s.
Discard the flow-through in the collection tube into liquid waste.
Repeat these steps for the remaining 750μL of the mixture.

steps.title: Wash Silica Column
steps.instruction: Perform two sequential washes of the silica spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 500μL of Buffer PB and centrifuge for 30–60s; discard flow-through.
Add 0.75 ml Buffer PE and centrifuge for 30–60s; discard flow-through.

steps.title: Remove Residual Buffer
steps.instruction: After discarding the final flow-through, centrifuge at full speed for an additional 1 min to remove residual PE buffer.

steps.title: Dry the Column
steps.instruction: Evaporate residual ethanol for 10-15 minutes at 50-60°C.

substeps.instruction: Remove the column from the collection tube and place it on a kimwipe in a 50°C oven, OR
Place the column into a fresh collection/eppendorf tube and use a heat block at 50-60°C.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Place the silica spin column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and elute the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 30-100 μl TE/Water/EB to the center of the column.
Let stand for 1 min, then centrifuge for 1 min.
Optional: Pipette flow-through back into the center of the column and centrifuge again to increase final concentration.

steps.title: Quantify Yield
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA yield using a nanodrop or by running an agarose gel.
